business_summary: Playmates Toys Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the design, development, marketing, and distribution of toys and family entertainment activity products. The company offers its products under the Animal Rescue, Mighty Morphin Power Rangers, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, Mutant Mayhem, Tales Of The Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, Classic Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, Monsterverse, Miraculous Ladybug, and Winx Club brands. It has operations in Hong Kong, the United States, Europe, North America, Latin America and the Asia Pacific, including Australia, and internationally. The company was founded in 1966 and is based in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong. Playmates Toys Limited operates as a subsidiary of PIL Toys Limited.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Playmates Toys Limited는 장난감 및 가족 오락 활동 제품의 디자인, 개발, 마케팅 및 유통에 참여하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 Animal Rescue, Mighty Morphin Power Rangers, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, Mutant Mayhem, Tales Of The Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, Classic Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, Monsterverse, Miraculous Ladybug 및 Winx Club 브랜드로 제품을 제공합니다. 홍콩, 미국, 유럽, 북미, 라틴 아메리카, 아시아 태평양(호주 포함) 및 국제적으로 사업장을 운영하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 1966년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 침사추이에 본사를 두고 있습니다. Playmates Toys Limited는 PIL Toys Limited의 자회사로 운영됩니다.
